verdict.rationale: Lium lets users and agents control pod lifetime. A TTL, end time or spend cap triggers automatic pod deletion, and agents can remove pods programmatically. Pod local volumes are also backed up every 6 hours and kept for 2 days, a fixed retention window with no documented user control. Missing for 10: user-configurable backup retention or opt-out, documented deletion of persistent Volumes and backups, explicit data-deletion guarantees or policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Pick one, and the pod is deleted when it is reached: Hours... End time... Spend cap: a budget in USD
the pod's local volume is backed up every 6 hours and kept 2 days, so you can restore it on another node
An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.
